title: Ring Network Reconstruction Schema
description: Rebuilds a band along each boundary of two honeycomb grains stacked along x as the dual of their hexagon centres: one atom per Delaunay triangle of the centres, settled to the bond length, the atoms outside the bands kept.

supercell_matrices.description: Supercell matrix of each grain, rows the vector across the boundary and the vector along it

slide.description: Shift of the second grain's hexagon centres along the boundary, in angstrom
